notes: latency is the model forward only (feature extraction, nearest-neighbour search, anomaly map); image decode and resize are excluded, as in the CLIP numbers
input is seeded noise at 224x224; pixel content does not affect CPU timing
peak RAM is the peak working set above an idle Python process with torch and anomalib imported, measured in a fresh process after loading the model and bank
the memory bank is a 10% coreset of ALL training patches, so cost grows with the training set size, unlike the few-shot prototype memory
